description: The error contract of the Slen SDKs: which typed error a wire code becomes, in every language. `types` is the hierarchy (a type is the class `Slen\Sdk\Exceptions\{Type}Exception` in PHP, `{Type}Error` in TypeScript and `slen.{Type}Error` in Python; `Slen` is the root). Python's `TimeoutError` and `ConnectionError` extend the built-in exception of the same name besides their type here, so code that catches the built-in one catches the SDK's as well. `codes` is the table every SDK carries: a code listed here always becomes its type, whatever the status; `status` is what the backend answers it with — FOR REFERENCE ONLY: no SDK decides anything by it and nothing holds it against the backend (the OpenAPI spec has no code-to-status map to hold it against), so no caller should rely on one. `fallback` is what a code outside the table becomes, by HTTP status. `local` is the codes the SDKs raise themselves — no server sends them — and the type each travels in; a type with no code at all (`Connection`, and `Timeout` for the SDK's own clock) is raised with a null code. Each SDK builds its error-mapping tests from this file — change the file and the table of every SDK in one round. The rules are in the AGENTS.md of each package.

invalid_request.raised: a call refused before anything is sent: an empty path value (an external user id, an execution id, a credit type) or idempotency key; credits that are not a decimal string of at most four places, or not an amount the movement takes (a top-up or a charge above zero, a correction other than zero); an empty `customer` or credit type; a `customer` that differs from `context.user_id`; a timeout or `retries` of a single call (`RequestOptions`, the keyword options in Python) out of range

invalid_response.raised: a 2xx whose body cannot be read; carries the status it came with

webhook_signature_invalid.raised: a webhook whose Slen-Signature does not hold; `reason` says which check refused it: missing_header, malformed_header, outside_tolerance, no_matching_signature

webhook_payload_invalid.raised: a webhook with a valid signature whose body is not an event: not JSON, or no id, type, created_at or data that can be read
